title: Hearty Silky Korean Mediterranean Chwinamul Pilaf
description: A rich and savory pilaf dish featuring chwinamul, score-fat, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, perfect for a satisfying brunch.
instructions: Heat the score-fat in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chwinamul and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, one cup at a time, stirring continuously and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the feta cheese, Kalamata olives, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the pilaf in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
